about: IPO ExitIQ public prediction log. This file is committed to git BEFORE each IPO lists; the commit date is the timestamp and cannot be backdated. After each listing, actual_close_pct and result are filled in — win or lose.
miss_definition: A prediction is a MISS if the actual listing-day closing gain has the opposite sign to the headline estimate, OR differs from it by more than 15 percentage points. Defined in advance on 2026-10-29; not to be redefined later.

predictions.note: Recorded while subscription was still open; final subscription figures may move the live verdict.

worked_examples_not_counted.note: Model replay built AFTER listing (the builder's own trade: 12 shares allotted at Rs 1,119, sold at Rs 1,358 = +21.4%). Shown as a worked example only — never counted in the scorecard.
